script_text: Stop, Aries — Saturn is conjunct your ruling planet Mars in your 1st House of Self right now, and the pressure you feel is real. Saturn at 18° Aries is physically sitting on top of Mars in your 1st House of Self, demanding you take command of your identity. Meanwhile, the Sun in Virgo is squaring your 10th House Midheaven, creating friction between your daily responsibilities and your long-term ambitions. Venus in Libra is lighting up your 7th House of Partnerships, so someone close to you needs more attention than usual — don't let work steal your focus tonight. Jupiter in Gemini is expansive in your 10th House of Career, making this the ideal moment to pitch that bold idea to leadership — money and recognition are aligned. Avoid making impulsive financial commitments before midnight — your Fire-sign impulsiveness could twist the details under Mercury's shadow. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
